name: obsidian-kingdone-chapel
description: Open the current Bible chapter/verse in another version (ARA, NVI, NVT, ACF, NTLH, MENS...).

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.precommit: npm run format && npm run build && npm run test:coverage
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Kelvin Stinghen
